title: Circular No. (26/4/5735) dated 19/5/2020 regarding Customers Account/ Electronic Money
text:
ميحرلا نمحرلا الله مسب
)11/01/1/1( جذومن
Number: 26/4/ 5735
Date: Ramadan 26, 1441
Corresponding to: May 19, 2020
Circular to Banks Operating in the Kingdom
Subject: Customers Account/ Electronic Money
Greetings,
Pursuant to Article (50) of the Central Bank Law and the provisions of the Financial
Collateral Instructions for Electronic Payment and Money Transfer Services Companies
No. (1/ 2018) regarding customers account/ electronic money for electronic payment and
money transfer companies licensed under the Electronic Payment and Money Transfer
Bylaw No. (111) of 2017, and in line with the government’s efforts to reduce the use of
paper-based transactions due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and to expedite the process of
withdrawing funds from customers account/ electronic money by mobile payment service
providers, the following procedures for withdrawing from customer accounts/ electronic
money have been established:
 Provide the Central Bank with the names of liaison officers responsible for
customers account/ electronic money for each company and their contact
information (email, phone number, and job title) via the designated email of the
Central Bank for withdrawal purposes: Payment.dep.studies@cbj.gov.jo.
 The liaison officers of the bank where the customer account/ electronic money
account is held are contacted to provide the Central Bank with the account balance
through an email sent to them.
 Upon approval of the withdrawal process by the central bank, a withdrawal approval
letter will be sent to the bank responsible for the customers account/ electronic
money belonging to the company via email, with a copy sent to the requesting
company and the Jordanian Company for Payment and Clearing Systems to take the
necessary action.
Respectfully
Governor
Dr. Ziad Fariz
